title: Read configuration frame
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ work tapes, and let $r,s$ be distinct tape indices such that the head on tape $r$ is at position $0$. For any state label $l$, input-head position $ip$, and natural number $k$, the configuration obtained from $c$ by entering state $l$, setting the input-head position to $ip$, and replacing tape $s$ by the binary representation of $k$ with its head at $0$ satisfies the following: its state is present, its input-head position is unrestricted, its output is unchanged, only tape $s$'s contents are changed, and the head positions are obtained by changing those on tapes $s$ and $r$; both resulting positions lie between $-1$ and the length of the binary representation of $|x|+1$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean input list $x$ and a configuration $c$
The head on tape $r$ is at position $0$
